slot.brief: Count the number of onto (surjective) functions from a set with m elements to a set with n elements using inclusion–exclusion formula n!·S(m,n).

stem: The number of onto functions from a set with $6$ elements to a set with $4$ elements is
solution:
By inclusion–exclusion, subtract functions missing at least one codomain element:
$$N=4^6-\binom41 3^6+\binom42 2^6-\binom43 1^6=4096-2916+384-4=1560.$$
